title: Legal Protections for National Servicemen against Workplace Discrimination arising from National Service Obligations
what_it_is: Legal Protections for National Servicemen against Workplace Discrimination arising from National Service Obligations

sections.label: Workplace Fairness Act and NSmen
sections.summary: The Workplace Fairness Act covers protected characteristics behind about 95% of discrimination complaints, while NSmen are protected under Tripartite Guidelines and the Enlistment Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Workplace Fairness Act takes a calibrated approach by covering the protected characteristics that account for approximately 95% of discrimination complaints received by TAFAP and MOM.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM will consider expanding the Workplace Fairness Act scope if evidence emerges of a sustained or significant increase in other forms of discrimination complaints.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: NSmen are protected under the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices, which prohibits all forms of workplace discrimination, including discrimination based on NS obligations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In egregious cases, MOM may suspend the employers' work pass privileges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Part 6 of the Enlistment Act separately sets out specific statutory duties for employers in relation to their employees' NS obligations, including reinstating employees after NS, granting leave of absence for NS obligations and not dismissing employees on account of their NS obligations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Foo Cexiang) (for the Acting Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To date, MINDEF has not had to pursue formal enforcement action under these provisions.

sections.label: Employer support for NS obligations
sections.summary: Employers in Singapore have been very supportive of employees' NS obligations, with few NS-related concerns raised, and legislation will be reviewed where needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang
sentences.text: Second, the general proportion, general significant number of our employers in Singapore, have been very supportive of our employees' NS obligations, and I think this has been borne out in the very low number of NS-related concerns that has been raised to MINDEF, MOM or TAFEP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang
sentences.text: But that being said, we continue to look closely at this feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Foo Cexiang
sentences.text: And where there is a need, as I mentioned earlier, where there are significant cases, we will review our legislation.
